instruction: Process all desktop images simultaneously with GIMP, applying a sharpening filter set to strength 80 via batch mode.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because applying sharpening filters in batch mode across multiple images requires GIMP scripting (Script-Fu/Python-Fu) to automate filter parameters and processing. The inability to reliably verify that specific filter strengths were applied to multiple images makes this task not evaluable in the OSWorld environment.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as 'infeasible' - the instruction requires verifying specific sharpening filter strength (80) applied to multiple images via batch processing
Verification would require: (1) Confirming specific filter strength parameter was used, not just that images are sharper; (2) Verifying batch processing was used instead of one-by-one processing
Available metric 'check_sharper' can only verify if images are sharper, but cannot verify the specific strength parameter (80 vs 50 vs 100)
GIMP does not expose filter parameter history in a way that can be reliably verified without accessing internal script logs or metadata
The metadata explanation correctly identifies why this task cannot be reliably evaluated in the OSWorld environment
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the semantically correct choice for this task
